what: EXP-OPE-RES-02 design-time TAB-R3 stand-in sizing; synthetic and data-free; a sizing, not a result
data_statement: no real row, ledger, model artifact, TRAIN marginal, sealed output or 2026 file is read; synthetic TAB marginals from the EXP-OPE-RES-01 test fixture; nothing is fitted to data; no registration is needed

definitions.D0: TAB logging law pi_b (archetype x count x group); reference policy = D0; candidate = KL tilt of D0 (TabWorld, mean KL 0.0074)
definitions.xi: sqrt(1-omega^2)*eps + omega*zbar; eps ~ N(0,1) per (count, archetype, group) from SeedSequence([20261028, 7, world_seed]); zbar = situation average of (Q_world - q_hat) standardized over the support
definitions.D2: D0*exp(theta*xi) renormalized on the D0 support; theta by bisection: D0-visitation-weighted mean KL(D2||D0) = klm x 0.048863351237125756
definitions.laws: t: b_t ~ D0^(1-t) D2^t; V3: D0^0.5 (the A2 T-A2 law)
definitions.beta: [beta_B0, beta_B2] = exact E[Delta_hat_DR] - Delta_true with the D0 / D2 denominator (pure baseline / pure swap), kappa = zeta = 0, uniform starts; beta_lambda = the same with the shrinkage weight lambda*rho/(rho^2+lambda) at a fixed lambda (descriptive)
definitions.ess: ESS ratio D2 over D0 denominator, ESS/N = E[W]^2/E[W^2] with W the PA-end product of rho (exact); null = infinite second moment in the two-strike foul loop
definitions.q99_max: [D0, D2] decision-level rho quantile 0.99 and max, weights = visits under the law x the law
definitions.swap_cells: exact pure-swap outcomes: C1 |beta_B2(t0)| <= B; C2 |beta_B2(V3)| <= |beta_B0(V3)| + B; C5 |beta_B2(t1)| <= B (identity); C6 |beta_B2(t2)| <= |beta_B0(t2)| + B

eta: eta_p (A2 rule ECE10 = 2 x 0.0087, recalibrated per synthetic world)
